definitions.expectancy_per_trade: E_trade = Sum(net_pnl) / N_trades (measures quality of executed positions)
definitions.portfolio_total_return: R_portfolio = Sum(net_pnl) / initial_equity (measures aggregate portfolio growth)

denominator_separation_audit.pairing_requirement: Candidate-level pairing (Group A vs Group B on identical candidate timestamps) is mandatory for matched-pairs bootstrap

moving_block_bootstrap_calibration.audit_remedy: Replaced uniform 48-bar block (which yielded 12h on 15m and 48d on 1d) with timeframe-calibrated block mapping
